review.reviewBody: Joe is a consummate professional! Encyclopedic knowledge of guitars, but also just a kind, generous, and helpful person. Highly recommend supporting Joe's Vintage Guitars!
Joe gave me an accurate and fair appraisal for my vintage Gibson. I love how passionate he is about his craft and the genuine care he puts into his business.
Joe is a true professional! I was very impressed with his knowledge and insights as it relates to vintage guitars. Joe is an expert of the highest order!
